data.final_week_advice: Focus on mastering the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus and Riemann sums, as these are your weak points. Use the second week for timed practice to ensure you can apply integration concepts under exam conditions.
data.summary: This two-week plan prioritizes your weak unit, Unit 6, in the first week to build a strong foundation in integration. The second week focuses on mixed review and timed practice to solidify all units and prepare for the exam.

weeks.focus: Mastering Unit 6: Integration and Accumulation of Change
tasks: Do 10 free-response questions on Riemann sums, then mark them against the scoring guide
Solve 5 problems on the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus, explaining each step
Review notes on accumulation functions and complete 3 practice problems

weeks.focus: Mixed review and timed practice for all units
tasks: Complete a 90-minute timed practice exam, then review all incorrect answers
Do 5 free-response questions on limits and continuity, then mark them against the scoring guide
Solve 3 problems on differential equations and slope fields, explaining your reasoning
